name: anymd
description: Converts any file to clean Markdown for AI agents: PDF, DOCX, PPTX, XLSX/CSV, EPUB, HTML and web URLs, images (EXIF, optional OCR) and audio/video metadata and subtitles. Tools: read (paged Markdown with page citation anchors and a token budget), search (literal or BM25-ranked across files, folders and URLs) and inspect (PDF page rendering, regions, structure, compare). Local Rust binary, no API key. Formerly pdf-reader-mcp.
